name: sa-music-on-nauvis
title: Space Age Music on Nauvis
author: Quell
description: Plays the Space Age soundtrack (Vulcanus, Fulgora, Gleba, Aquilo and space platform music) in games where the Space Age mod is disabled. The music is copied from your own Space Age installation by build.ps1; it is not included in this mod's source and must not be redistributed. Does nothing while Space Age is enabled.
